title: The Ganymede Takeover
author: Philip K. Dick and Ray Nelson
card_summary: A collaborative novel by Dick and his friend Ray Nelson (1967), set on an Earth conquered by worm-like aliens from Ganymede. Human resistance forces use psychedelic drugs, music, and guerrilla tactics against the occupiers. The only novel Dick co-wrote with Nelson, his Berkeley friend and fellow SF writer. Ace Books edition, 164 pages.

## **AN ARMY OF APPARITIONS** 

**It began when three guerrillas made a raid for supplies and food. They were having a hard time, because the border defenders were keeping them off with lasers.** 

**"'So I figured I'd rustle up some reinforcements with the illusion machine," reported the troop leader. "Well, the gadget zapped up twenty-four men and they all fought like veterans, then helped us to carry the supplies we captured up into the mountains. That was fine, I guess, except I don't see how an il usion can lift a boxful of real canned food.**
